scope.interactionChannel: built-in Computer Use against exact-owned PID and window

observations.name: horizontal split lifecycle
observations.detail: A real pointer opened Terminal, activated the horizontal split control, rendered Terminal 1 and Terminal 2 as simultaneous side-by-side viewports, and closed Terminal 2 back to one pane.

observations.name: vertical split lifecycle
observations.detail: From the restored single-pane state, a real pointer activated the vertical split control and rendered Terminal 1 and Terminal 2 as simultaneous stacked viewports.

observations.name: active pane command routing
observations.detail: Real keyboard input and Run clicks routed NATIVE_VERTICAL_TERM_2 to the lower vertical pane, NATIVE_HORIZONTAL_TERM_2 to the right horizontal pane, and NATIVE_HORIZONTAL_TERM_1 to the left pane after selecting Terminal 1.

classification.productLoss: No functional Native split or command-routing loss was observed.
